keyPoints.en: Types: int, float, str, bool. input() returns str — convert with int() or float().
keyPoints.bm: Jenis: int, float, str, bool. input() memulangkan str — tukar dengan int() atau float().

keyPoints.en: print() displays output. Variable names cannot start with a digit.
keyPoints.bm: print() memaparkan output. Nama pemboleh ubah tidak boleh bermula dengan digit.

keyPoints.en: Comparison: == != < > <= >=. Use = to assign, == to compare.
keyPoints.bm: Perbandingan: == != < > <= >=. Gunakan = untuk umpukan, == untuk perbandingan.

keyPoints.en: if / elif / else need a colon and an indented block.
keyPoints.bm: if / elif / else perlukan titik bertindih dan blok berinden.

keyPoints.en: range(5) → 0–4; range(1, 6) → 1–5; range(2, 10, 2) → 2, 4, 6, 8. while repeats until the condition is False.
keyPoints.bm: range(5) → 0–4; range(1, 6) → 1–5; range(2, 10, 2) → 2, 4, 6, 8. while berulang sehingga syarat False.

tip.en: Trace loops on paper, one line at a time.
tip.bm: Surih gelung di atas kertas, satu baris demi satu baris.
